name: guition-catalog
description: Static searchable catalog of ESP32 display boards (Guition, Waveshare, M5Stack, LilyGO, Elecrow, Seeed, Makerfabs, DFRobot)

scripts.build: python3 build/build_site.py && python3 build/features.py && python3 build/offline.py && python3 build/photos.py && python3 build/icons.py && python3 build/seo.py && node build/build_index.mjs && python3 build/gen_sw.py
scripts.test: python3 tests/check_links.py && python3 tests/check_seo.py && python3 tests/e2e.py
